A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OCP study, DEC algorithm, and benchmarks, and their supplied pages are readable. However, v3 ends with references on page 12 despite repeatedly referring to an appendix; v4 includes Appendices A.1–A.7. Earlier supplementary material is therefore unavailable for comparison.

before.justification: V3 reports original DEC comparisons across four datasets in Tables 1–4, together with logit-norm analysis and a regularizer ablation.

after.justification: V4 retains original experimental results and reports additional NLL measurements and appendix results in Tables 7–11.

M1.justification: V4 removes the beta parameter and Freeze_b_Layers step from DEC Algorithm 2, eliminating v3's partial-freezing design. The core CCR computation and final temperature scaling remain. The reported loss also changes from BCE to CE, although v3 does not expand BCE; the PDFs do not establish whether retained experiments were rerun.

E1.justification: Both versions use PACS, Home Office, Digits comprising USPS/MNIST/SVHN, and TIN-C: the same 26 domain shifts, including 15 with five corruption levels. The TTA terminology and additional backbone-result reporting do not introduce new task coverage.

E2.justification: Matched experimental comparisons retain No Adapt, TENT, T3A, ETA, and SoTTA. Newly discussed related methods are not added as evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: V4 adds NLL alongside accuracy and 15-bin ECE. Figure 2 changes the logit-norm summary from the median to the bottom 20% quantile. The stated leave-one-out protocols, backbone families, and single adaptation iteration remain; newly supplied appendix settings do not establish experimental reruns.

E4.justification: Figure 2 revises the corruption-severity analysis to examine the lower logit-norm quantile instead of the median, providing different evidence about low-norm observations. Figure 3 retains the CCR-versus-fixed-temperature ablation. Additional appendix benchmark tables are not new ablations.

E5.justification: Both versions state three runs and report domain variability and significance claims. V4 additionally supplies seeds 0, 1, and 2, maximum run-to-run variances, and clarification that significance comparisons use the second-best algorithm. These are reporting additions, not evidence of more runs.

E6.justification: NLL results throughout the main tables and newly supplied Tables 7–11 substantially expand reported evidence; for example, v4 Table 4 reports Digits NLL of 1.422 for DEC and 1.889 for T3A. Earlier accuracy/ECE/entropy entries are largely reproduced with rounding. PACS maximum domain variances change from [0.01, 0.02, 0.12] to [0.020, 0.014, 0.075]. Additional reporting does not establish newly conducted experiments.

T1.justification: V4 Appendix A.4 supplies explicit memory-cost equations for DEC and its comparators, accounting for two full backbone parameter sets for DEC, versus v3's beta-dependent overhead bound. The expanded CCR formula restates the existing algorithm; no theorem or proof is added.

C1.justification: V4 retains the OCP and DEC contributions but explicitly restricts its general claims to entropy-reducing TTA methods, adds NLL superiority to its headline calibration claims, and withdraws v3's memory-efficiency and low-resource contribution. The introduction's claim of leading accuracy uplifts remains.

C2.justification: V4 connects calibration degradation with representation drift and over-adaptation in Appendix A.3, expands safety and fairness implications, and suggests that improved calibration could improve reliability estimates in Section 6.3. The principal entropy/logit-norm mechanism explanation remains.

D1.justification: V4 supplies preprocessing instructions, dataset-specific temperature bounds, training and comparator hyperparameters, software/hardware details, computational expenditure, and the SmallCNN architecture in its appendix, plus a code-release link. These are newly available disclosures for retained experiments. Conversely, v3's explicit DEC adaptation learning rate of 0.001 is omitted.

R1.justification: V4 substantively positions the study within entropy-reducing TTA and distinguishes it from other adaptation and calibration settings. Appendix A.3 discusses Wang, Gong, Wald, and Hu, and expands the relationship to the already-cited Press et al. work. New calibration and fairness literature further broadens positioning beyond bibliographic restyling.

P1.justification: V4 substantially reorganizes and expands the narrative: OCP, DEC, experiments, and results become separate sections; the method gains dedicated explanatory subsections; a motivation subsection is added; and discussion replaces the earlier conclusion structure. Terminology, title, publication header, and citation style also change.

P2.justification: V4 combines entropy/ECE subtables with new NLL blocks, reformats the Digits/PACS tables, places both algorithms together, enlarges and juxtaposes Figures 2–3, and adds appendix tables and the SmallCNN architecture figure. These extensive display changes accompany the journal-template layout.

improvement.justification: V4 improves completeness and reproducibility by supplying the previously missing technical appendix, adds complementary NLL evidence, and better defines the claims' scope. Reporting problems temper these gains: Table 10's No Adapt NLL of 2.184 does not match Table 1's per-domain arithmetic mean of about 2.485, and v3's explicit DEC learning rate disappears. The net improvement is useful but qualified.
